description: P0-P3 production deployment secrets and variables required for release gates.

secrets.name: DATABASE_URL
secrets.purpose: PostgreSQL connection string with imported seed and worker artifacts.

secrets.name: ADMIN_REVIEW_SESSION_SECRET
secrets.purpose: Signs HttpOnly admin review session cookies.

secrets.name: ADMIN_REVIEW_ADMIN_PASSWORD
secrets.purpose: Admin login password for protected review operations.

secrets.name: ADMIN_REVIEW_REVIEWER_PASSWORD
secrets.purpose: Reviewer login password for approve/reject review operations.

secrets.name: LLM_EXTRACT_URL
requiredFor: weekly research refresh with http LLM
secrets.purpose: HTTP LLM gateway endpoint that accepts ai_capital_extract_candidates requests.

secrets.name: LLM_EXTRACT_API_KEY
requiredFor: weekly research refresh with http LLM
secrets.purpose: Bearer token for the HTTP LLM gateway.

optionalSecrets.name: ADMIN_REVIEW_TOKEN
optionalSecrets.purpose: Legacy single-token admin review API auth.

vars.name: LLM_EXTRACT_MODEL
vars.purpose: Model identifier passed to the LLM gateway.
